manual_notes: No retained SynVoy BGN candidate, named BGN model, or canonical BGN protein was found in the Branchiostoma floridae inputs. In this pre-vertebrate comparison, absence of a gene-specific call is not sufficient to infer gene loss.

The biglycan-like model is at NC_052166.1:4337032-4377582, whereas SynVoy's HIGH hit on NC_052156.1 was reassigned to ASPN. A 40-gene comparison recovers MECP2, RPL10, and TAFAZZIN in conserved order around the canonical model. XP_038638277.1 has a strong SignalP call, conserved comparable cysteines and SLRP/LRR domains, but lacks about 111 human-equivalent C-terminal residues and remains an embedding outlier; retain it as a tentative partial BGN ortholog.

The GFF gene is labelled BGN, but its CDS product is asporin. Six ASPN-locus neighbours and the focused protein tree support ASPN rather than BGN; SynVoy's separate medium BGN-like hit was reassigned to DCN. Exclude XP_414298.2 from the canonical BGN panel.

No annotated biglycan model or canonical BGN protein was found. SynVoy's only HIGH BGN-labelled candidate was reassigned to DCN, so the present assembly does not resolve an elephant-shark BGN ortholog.

Fifteen human BGN-block anchors are shared in perfect oriented order around opossum ATP2B3, but no BGN model lies between ATP2B3 and HAUS7. The paired inputs are incompatible on chromosome X (GFF NC_077235.2 versus FASTA NC_077235.1), and focused TBLASTN of the approximate older-FASTA interval found no hit; rerun with matching inputs before interpreting absence.
No retained SynVoy DCN candidate, named DCN model, or canonical protein was available in Branchiostoma floridae. The deep-lineage result is uninformative for a one-to-one DCN assignment.

The retained SynVoy model overlaps the annotated DCN locus at NC_088145.1:114048728-114126931. Eight exact human flanking genes retain order, the canonical protein lies in the DCN clade, and the completed SignalP run supports a classical signal peptide.

The canonical dcn locus at NC_090702.1:16396890-16423580 shares eight ordered anchors with human, including the EPYC-KERA-LUM-DCN cluster. SynVoy retained no DCN call, but locus, reciprocal-protein, tree, domain and completed SignalP evidence agree.

The canonical dcn locus at NC_133179.1:16955805-16993841 preserves the EPYC-KERA-LUM-DCN block and BTG1 in order. SynVoy's HIGH raw hit was a paralog, while the RefSeq protein, DCN-clade placement, domain architecture and completed SignalP call support the annotated locus.

XP_038636759.1 maps to the exact high-confidence DCN locus, spans the full human-aligned region, conserves all six comparable cysteines, carries SLRP/LRR domains and lies inside the fully supported DCN tree split. SignalP predicts secretion with cleavage at residues 45-46; the later cleavage and N-terminal extension are retained as a transcript-model caveat rather than grounds for excluding the ortholog.

The retained SynVoy interval at NC_049983.1:12339566-12340792 overlaps a RUN-domain Beclin-1-interacting protein-like gene, not EPYC. No canonical EPYC protein or conserved EPYC block supports this call.

The retained model overlaps the annotated EPYC locus at NC_088145.1:113783413-113830371. Ten exact human flanking genes preserve order, and reciprocal protein, EPYC-clade, domain, and SignalP evidence outweigh the exploratory embedding outlier.

The canonical epiphycan model at NW_024704746.1:33285071-33298586 is one of the retained SynVoy rescue loci, although the summary's highest-identity tandem fragment is elsewhere. Seven exact human anchors preserve order, including KERA-LUM-DCN, and protein/tree/SignalP evidence supports XP_007893502.1.

The canonical EPYC locus at NC_090702.1:16496431-16523089 shares 11 ordered flanking genes with human, including the DCN-LUM-KERA-EPYC cluster and ATP2B1-POC1B-DUSP6-TMTC3-CEP290 block. Reciprocal BLAST, the EPYC phylogeny, LRR domains, and a strong signal peptide support XP_006633678.1; the two provisional SynVoy hits were KERA/LUM paralogs.

The canonical epyc locus at NC_133179.1:16906814-16920982 preserves KERA-LUM-DCN and BTG1 in order, whereas SynVoy's retained fragment is on NC_133200.1. Protein, tree, domain, and SignalP evidence support EPYC, but reduced query coverage warrants a tentative label.
The retained 45-bp SynVoy interval lies inside a bromodomain-containing protein 3-like gene, not FMOD. No canonical FMOD protein or conserved FMOD-PRELP locus supports the assignment.

The fibromodulin-like model at NC_052160.1:142715179-142734639 is separate from SynVoy's 54-bp fragment on NC_052156.1. Its adjacency to PRELP plus reciprocal protein, FMOD-clade, domain, and SignalP evidence supports the model, but sparse LOC annotations and the embedding concern keep it tentative.

Selected fmodb is a plausible teleost FMOD co-ortholog and the best full-length human FMOD match (50.9% identity over 99% query coverage), but its locus has weak ancestral synteny. fmoda NP_001025243.1 is at the conserved FMOD-PRELP locus and has 56.6% identity over 80% coverage; retain both explicitly as duplicated co-ortholog evidence.

The retained SynVoy fragment at NC_049983.1:12602582-12603646 is intergenic in the exact GFF and has no canonical protein or tree support. Treat it only as an unresolved LUM-like fragment, not a confirmed ortholog.

The annotated lum locus at NC_052165.1:37258201-37272456 contains XP_038636708.1 and shares six human anchors, including KERA-LUM-DCN, with conserved broader order. SynVoy's two retained fragments are elsewhere and the canonical-locus rescue was misassigned to FMOD; protein/tree/domain/SignalP evidence confirms LUM.

The canonical LUM locus at NC_088145.1:113890958-113908026 shares nine exact human anchors in perfect oriented order, including EPYC-KERA-LUM-DCN. The retained SynVoy fragments do not map to this gene, but reciprocal protein, tree, domain, and SignalP evidence support the annotated locus.

The canonical lum locus at NC_090702.1:16450380-16457870 shares nine exact human anchors in perfect oriented order, including DCN-LUM-KERA-EPYC. SynVoy's retained fragments are elsewhere; reciprocal protein, LUM-clade, domain, and SignalP evidence support XP_015208177.1.

All 21 HIGH/MEDIUM raw Branchiostoma floridae OGN hits were reassigned to other genes; the highest overlaps an endoribonuclease LACTB2-like model. The manually reviewed XP_066265713.1 is from Branchiostoma lanceolatum, not the SynVoy species/assembly, and remains only an uncertain SLRP-like provenance sequence outside confident OGN.
No retained SynVoy PRELP candidate, named PRELP model, or canonical protein was available in Branchiostoma floridae. The deep-lineage result cannot establish a gene-specific PRELP ortholog.

The canonical prelp locus at NC_052160.1:142404483-142432733 is separate from SynVoy's retained partial locus at 136 Mb. The canonical locus retains adjacency to the fibromodulin-like LOC119978081 model, and protein/tree/domain/SignalP evidence supports PRELP; sparse LOC annotation and the embedding outlier keep it tentative.

The canonical prelp locus at NC_133186.1:23181387-23192171 retains adjacent fmoda plus PPFIA4 and TMEM183A in the corresponding block. Reciprocal protein, PRELP-clade, domain, and SignalP evidence support XP_001923590.2 despite the missing SynVoy call.
